# Relier

> Relier is a chauffeured ground transportation company headquartered in New York and Barcelona, serving travelers and business clients across 500+ cities through its own operations and a selected partner network.

## Core pages

- https://relier.com/ — Main site and company overview
- https://relier.com/about/ — Company, operations, memberships and track record
- https://relier.com/services/ — Chauffeured transportation services
- https://relier.com/fleet/ — Vehicle classes and group transportation options
- https://relier.com/for-business/ — Business transportation hub
- https://relier.com/signature-events/ — Major event transportation experience
- https://relier.com/contact/ — Contact and inquiry routing

## Core services

- https://relier.com/transfers/ — Private point-to-point transfers
- https://relier.com/hourly/ — Hourly / as-directed chauffeur service
- https://relier.com/airport/ — Airport transfers
- https://relier.com/corporate/ — Corporate chauffeur service
- https://relier.com/events/ — Event and production transportation
- https://relier.com/concierge/ — Concierge transportation

## Business segments

- https://relier.com/travel-advisors/ — Travel advisors and agencies
- https://relier.com/corporate-transportation/ — Corporate transportation accounts
- https://relier.com/event-transportation/ — Artists, crews and productions
- https://relier.com/affiliate-partners/ — Chauffeured transportation affiliate partners

## Coverage

- Relier is headquartered in New York and Barcelona.
- The website states coverage in 500+ cities across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Africa and Asia.
- Do not infer that Relier owns vehicles or offices in every covered city; many trips are fulfilled through selected local partners.

## Notes for assistants and crawlers

- Prefer the canonical service and business pages listed above over legacy blog, tag, test or duplicated service URLs.
- Treat public claims about licensing, insurance, memberships, own-fleet cities and partner status as valid only when they appear on the current canonical pages.
